title: Production Dynamic Atmospheric Top-Boundary Provider Qualification

upstream_physics.F-PM06F_canonical_runtime: F-CI41 admitted restricted surface-evaporation runtime materialization

finding: The current explicit top-boundary provider interface cannot represent the admitted legacy B1.10 atmospheric boundary without loss of physics. HeadCalc's provider bridge forces ftoph=false, while the legacy boundary may switch between flux and prescribed-surface-head regimes. The head regime also requires the surface-face conductivity in the residual/Jacobian. Accepted ponding, evaporation partition and runoff values are not represented by the current provider result contract.

solver_contract.fact: top_boundary_provider_t returns only actual_top_flux, surface_head and runoff_flux

facts: vector_F evaluates the top boundary on every residual evaluation
the flux branch adds qtop directly to F(1)
the head branch uses hsurf and kmean(1) in F(1)
jacobian_F adds kmean(1)/disnod(1) only when ftoph is true
legacy pond-balance convergence uses pond, pondm1, reva, epd, runots and qtop

fixed_flux_provider.fact: fixed qtop, no regime switching, no runoff physics

evaporation_capacity.fact: qualified reusable Emax capability exists for the restricted default-MvG profile

surface_evaporation_runtime.fact: qualified committed-state demand/capacity materialization exists but does not own dynamic Newton-iterate top-boundary regime switching

next_gate: Freeze the minimal dynamic top-boundary evaluation/result contract and prove that it can carry legacy flux/head regime, surface-face conductance, accepted ponding, evaporation partition and runoff without hidden global state before implementing a provider.
